overview_description.description: Citymapper is a transport app for cities that uses the power of mobile and open transport data to help humans survive and master them. Citymapper is created to address urban mobility challenges. Citymapper employs a method for generating the most accurate mobility data worldwide. It is intended for humans in real-time, multimodal cities, and has been enhanced by billions of real-world searches and choices.

product.name: Citymapper App
product.description: A mobile transportation app for planning and navigating journeys across public transit, walking, cycling, scooters, and other urban mobility options.

product.name: Citymapper CLUB
product.description: A subscription offering that provides additional Citymapper app features, including enhanced trip tracking, departure-time planning, and navigation capabilities.

product.name: Citymapper for Cities
product.description: A service for cities and transport agencies that provides journey planning, rider insights, and tools for evaluating and optimizing transportation networks.

product.name: Citymapper Advertising
product.description: An advertising service that enables brands to reach commuters in major cities through location- and context-oriented ad formats and targeting capabilities.
